opening.argument: The central purpose is a practical demonstration of how to contact Facebook support through Messenger: the speaker says, "I'm going to show you how you can contact Facebook support" and identifies the method as "using messenger." The interface visibly provides support categories and a route to "Chat with a representative," making the tutorial concrete and operational. Its presentation is also appropriately limited: "the chat is not available all the time," and support is not promised to resolve every problem, since it may not be "able to help you with whatever issue that you might be having." Separate affiliate and income-related promotions, including the "$100/Day" claim, are qualified by an earnings disclaimer and are not shown to require payment, request credentials, lead to a deceptive destination, or connect to the support tutorial.
